title: perf: canary auto-detection for latency/throughput regressions + rollout guards
author: Priya Malhotra
release_notes: Adds automatic regression detection for performance canaries with adaptive rollout guards. Default behavior is opt-in via canary policy; rollout abort on detected regressions. Includes dashboards and tests.
description:
Context and motivation: We've had a number of incidents where subtle latency regressions slipped through canary rollouts because the detector thresholds were static and noisy. This PR adds an automated detector that watches canary cohorts (p50/p95 latency and throughput) and flags statistically significant regressions as well as engineering heuristics for sustained throughput degradation. The detector is integrated with the rollout controller via a new RolloutGuard that can pause/abort canaries automatically, and it exposes conservative defaults plus tunable hysteresis to reduce false positives.

What this PR does (single continuous description): Implements a canary performance detector (perf-canary/detector.py) that computes distribution-aware deltas between baseline and canary windows and performs an adaptive significance test and rate-of-change checks. Adds a RolloutGuard (serving/rollout/rollout_guard.py) that subscribes to detector findings and applies canary policies (abort, pause, mark degraded) with configurable hysteresis and cooldown. Exposes a canary policy schema (api/schemas/canary_policy.yaml) with fields: sensitivity, min-samples, sample-window, cooldown, and fallback-models. Adds observability: metrics (metrics/perf_canary_metrics.go) for alerting, and a Grafana dashboard JSON (observability/dashboards/canary_performance_overview.jsonnet). Adds unit and integration tests (tests/perf_canary/test_detector.py, tests/perf_canary/test_rollout_guard_integration.py) and updates the docs page (docs/perf-canary.md) with examples and tuning guidance.

Checklist: - [x] Detector implementation and tests - [x] RolloutGuard integration + policy schema - [x] Observability + dashboard - [x] Feature-flagged and opt-in by default - [x] Docs and runbook updates - [x] Performance tests (local canary harness)

Commits summary: See commits field for short messages. High level: initial detector prototype, add statistical test and hysteresis, integrate with rollout controller, add metrics and dashboards, tests and docs, lint/fixups.

Files changed (high level): detector and rollout guard implementations, API schema, metrics exporter, Grafana dashboard, tests, docs, helm values to enable feature flag per deployment.

CI: Initial runs failed lint and one flaky test; addressed lint errors and added deterministic seeding to the flaky test. Final CI: all checks passed.

Review and merging: Reviewed by Evan Clarke and Marta Ruiz; requested extra integration test to cover a long-tail race between detector windowing and rollout controller added test and addressed comments about signal smoothing and config names. PR approved and merged by squash. Merge method: squash and merge.

Motivation for reviewers: please pay attention to sensitivity defaults and cooldown interactions (docs/perf-canary.md contains recommended tuning). This change touches the critical rollout path so we gated it behind a canary_policy opt-in and a feature flag for the rollout controller to enable auto-abort behavior.
